description: This file defines filtering logic and data structures used in a recipe browsing UI, including an enum for cooking time categories and a class to encapsulate filter criteria, serialization, and matching logic.

classes.name: CookingTimeBucket
classes.description: An enum representing different predefined cooking time categories for recipes.

classes.name: RecipeFilters
classes.description: A class encapsulating filter criteria for recipes, including selected cuisines, diets, and cooking time buckets, with methods for filtering, serialization, and displaying summaries.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the current RecipeFilters with optional modifications to selected filters.

methods.name: summary
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string summarizing the active filters.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if a given recipe matches the current filter set.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the filter set into a map for persistence.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a map into a RecipeFilters instance.

methods.name: bucketForMinutes
methods.description: Maps cooking time in minutes to a predefined bucket.

methods.name: bucketLabel
methods.description: Provides a user-facing label for a given time bucket.
